title: Observable Outfitters · Business Impact
description: Shopping activity, dropoff after successful cart addition, product interest and checkout outcomes from Grafana Faro in 1-minute time buckets; product rankings cover the selected range. Dropoff requires no successful checkout and no new recorded session events for the configurable timeout: 60 seconds for the simulator demo or 15 minutes normally. Faro sessions group shopping journeys; browser telemetry is best effort.

list.name: idle_timeout_seconds
list.label: Dropoff timeout
list.description: Required time with no new recorded events for the same Faro session before counting dropoff. Requires a successful add-to-cart and no successful checkout. Demo default 60 seconds allows headroom for simulator navigation, payment waits, and telemetry delivery; choose 15 minutes normally. This is a dashboard rule, not Faro's session expiry.

panels.title: Active Sessions per Minute
panels.description: Distinct Faro sessions with at least one event in each 1-minute bucket. A session can appear in multiple buckets, so do not sum these bars to calculate total sessions. Sessions are not unique people; reloads do not add sessions. Sampling is 100%.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" [1m]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Dropoffs Percentage
panels.description: A session is a dropoff if it has at least one successful add-to-cart, has no successful checkout, and has produced no new recorded session events for the selected Dropoff timeout. For each 1-minute bucket, count qualified sessions whose last recorded event plus that timeout falls within the minute; show dropoffs as a percentage of all such qualified sessions. Browsing-only sessions, failed cart additions, and sessions with more recent events are excluded from both counts. Successful cart additions and checkouts are checked across Faro's maximum four-hour session lifetime. Default 60 seconds for the simulator demo; choose 15 minutes normally. This uses recorded-event silence; there is no separate session-termination condition. Missing or delayed events can cause false classification. No eligible sessions shows no data; all eligible sessions converted shows 0%. Any successful checkout converts the whole Faro session.

targets.expr: 100 * ((count((((sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" [1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s))) unless (sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" [${idle_timeout_seconds}s])))) and (sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" | event_name="shop.cart_add" | event_data_outcome="success" [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s)))) unless (sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" | event_name="shop.checkout" | event_data_outcome="success" [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s))))) or vector(0)) / count((((sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" [1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s))) unless (sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" [${idle_timeout_seconds}s])))) and (sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | __error__="" | session_id!="" | event_name="shop.cart_add" | event_data_outcome="success" [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s)))))

panels.title: Views by Product
panels.description: Product page views in the selected range; repeat visits count again. Horizontal bars rank products by views.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_product_id) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_name="shop.product_view" [$__range]))

panels.title: Checkouts
panels.description: Completed checkout attempts per 1-minute bucket, stacked by success/fail. Every retry is a separate attempt; validation and payment failures are included. Pending attempts appear when they finish.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_name="shop.checkout" [1m]))

panels.title: Checkouts by Product
panels.description: Units purchased per product in the selected range, summed only after a successful checkout response. Declines and out-of-stock attempts contribute no units. Browser-observed purchases are not an accounting ledger.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_product_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_name="shop.product_purchased" | unwrap event_data_quantity | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Checkout Error Rate
panels.description: For each 1-minute bucket: failed checkout attempts / all completed attempts × 100. Retries count separately. No attempts shows no data; successful attempts with no failures show 0%.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_name="shop.checkout" | event_data_outcome="fail" [1m]))) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_name="shop.checkout" [1m]))
